approach: Power equals the energy released per fission multiplied by the number of fissions per second, so divide the required power by the energy per fission.

steps.text: Convert the energy released per fission from mega electron volts to joules.
Divide the required power by the energy released per fission to get the number of fissions per second.

common_mistakes.text: Using 100 MeV per fission instead of 200 MeV doubles the required rate, giving 8×10¹².
Using 400 MeV per fission instead of 200 MeV halves the required rate, giving 2×10¹².
